rows.name: Using CQC data
rows.semantic_limit: CQC provider, location and rating data describe regulated care services and published assessments; they do not establish current safety for an individual patient, household or exact parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The official CQC page states that its API includes active and inactive providers and locations, latest ratings and report dates, is updated daily, and is available under the Open Government Licence.

rows.name: CQC ratings and percentage scores
rows.semantic_limit: CQC ratings and percentage bands are regulatory judgements for assessed services; they must not be converted into a medical outcome prediction or neighbouring parcel score.
rows.evidence_basis: The official methodology defines Outstanding, Good, Requires improvement and Inadequate ratings and the percentage-score bands used in newer assessment reports.

rows.name: CQC services-in-area map, data sheets and API
rows.semantic_limit: Mapped service locations and latest published ratings support service discovery only; map proximity is not evidence of care availability, capacity, treatment quality or parcel safety.
rows.evidence_basis: The official CQC page links map search, downloadable spreadsheets and an API for regulated services and their latest ratings.

rows.name: CQC levels of ratings
rows.semantic_limit: Service, location and trust-level rating aggregation must remain at the published assessment level; values cannot be propagated to an address, resident or nearby parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The official guidance explains the levels at which CQC rates key questions, services, locations and NHS trusts.

rows.name: Incidents and Resilience Annual Report 2025/26
rows.semantic_limit: National incident, outbreak and signal-management findings support food-safety system context; they do not prove contamination or risk at a specific business, home or parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The official annual report covers incident response, outbreaks, signals, capability and data analysis for 2025/26.

rows.name: DVSA annual report and accounts 2025 to 2026
rows.semantic_limit: Agency activity, service and performance reporting is institutional road-safety context and cannot establish the condition of a specific vehicle, road segment or parcel.
rows.evidence_basis: The official DVSA annual report records agency activity and services for 2025 to 2026 across Great Britain.
